starting-out-talking-to-garth.speaker: Garth
starting-out-talking-to-garth.text: Hello there. Interested in hearing the tale of Serafina?

starting-out-talking-to-garth.prompt: Start the A Taste of Hope quest?

steps.speaker: Garth
steps.text: Great! Now, in case you didn't know, the castle before you is Ver Sinhaza. It's home to the Theatre of Blood.

steps.speaker: Garth
steps.text: Every day, vampyres from across Morytania come to the Theatre to watch as citizens attempt the various challenges within.

steps.player: So it's a form of entertainment for them? Why do the citizens take part?

steps.speaker: Garth
steps.text: The Theatre is run by a famous vampyre noble, Lady Verzik Vitur. She has promised that any citizen of Meiyerditch who survives the Theatre will be freed of the vampyre blood tithes.

steps.player: I suppose that must be rather tempting to a lot of people. So who's this Serafina?

steps.speaker: Garth
steps.text: The Theatre has been around for many years and thousands of people have tried their luck against it. However, in all that time, only one person has ever survived until the end.

steps.speaker: Garth
steps.text: Exactly. Serafina's younger brother was very ill and he wasn't going to survive many more blood tithes. She couldn't just let him die, so she did what no other person ever had.

steps.speaker: Garth
steps.text: She entered the Theatre and succeeded in every challenge she faced. They say that Verzik wasn't too happy about that, but she kept her promise. Serafina and her brother were freed.

steps.player: Sounds like you're a big fan of her.

steps.speaker: Garth
steps.text: Well of course. When she survived the Theatre, she provided hope to every person in Meiyerditch. Hope that they can one day follow in her footsteps.

steps.player: So what happened to her in the end?

steps.speaker: Garth
steps.text: Well I suppose she left Meiyerditch. Can't imagine any free person wanting to stick around here.

steps.player: You suppose? So you don't know for sure?

steps.speaker: Garth
steps.text: Well... No. It was a long time ago. Not many people around who remember it.
A cutscene plays in which Ranis Drakan and Vanstrom Klause arrive at Ver Sinhaza and enter the Theatre of Blood.

steps.player: That was Vanstrom Klause and Ranis Drakan!
Safalaan and the Myreque will want to hear about this.

starting-out-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
starting-out-talking-to-safalaan.text: It's nice to see you again, [player name], and congratulations on your well deserved promotion!

starting-out-talking-to-safalaan.player: Safalaan! I've seen something I think you should know about.
I was at Ver Sinhaza and I saw Vanstrom Klause and Ranis Drakan.
I'm not sure, they arrived at the same time and both entered the castle.

starting-out-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
starting-out-talking-to-safalaan.text: Ver Sinhaza is home to the Theatre of Blood. Maybe they were just there as spectators?

starting-out-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
starting-out-talking-to-safalaan.text: Hmmm. Ranis is known to visit the Theatre quite regularly. However, I've never heard of Vanstrom going there before. I'd say this is worth investigating.

starting-out-talking-to-safalaan.player: What do you need from me?

starting-out-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
starting-out-talking-to-safalaan.text: Return to Ver Sinhaza and see if you can work out what Vanstrom and Ranis are up to. If you need some help, we recently sent a few of King Roald's mercenaries in that direction.

starting-out-talking-to-safalaan-talking.player: What do you need me to do again?

starting-out-talking-to-safalaan-talking.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
starting-out-talking-to-safalaan-talking.text: Go to Ver Sinhaza and see if you can work out what Vanstrom and Ranis are up to. We recently sent a few of King Roald's mercenaries in that direction, talk to them if you need help.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-the-mercen.speaker: Mercenary
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-the-mercen.text: Hello. You don't look like the usual rabble around here. What's your story?

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-the-mercen.player: Safalaan sent me. He said you could help me with something.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-the-mercen.speaker: Mercenary
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-the-mercen.text: Ahh Safalaan. Interesting chap isn't he? Those eyes of his are a bit creepy.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-the-mercen.speaker: Mercenary
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-the-mercen.text: Anyway, we might be able to help but it will need to be quick. We're just about to head into the Theatre. Compared to the citizens, we shouldn't have any issues in there.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-the-mercen.speaker: Mercenary
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-the-mercen.text: So what help do you need?

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-the-mercen.player: I saw Vanstrom Klause and Ranis Drakan arriving at the castle earlier. Do you know if they're still here?

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-the-mercen.speaker: Mercenary
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-the-mercen.text: Yeah we saw them as well. Pretty hard to miss. We haven't seen them leave yet so I guess they're still inside.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-the-mercen.player: I need to know what they're doing in there. Any idea how I can do that?

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-the-mercen.speaker: Mercenary
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-the-mercen.text: Well this place has quite a few windows. Maybe you could use one of them. They're all high up though so you'd need to climb to reach them.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-the-mercen.speaker: Mercenary
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-the-mercen.text: Aye that might work. Parts of the castle wall have been damaged, it shouldn't be too hard to climb.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-the-mercen.speaker: Mercenary
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-the-mercen.text: Hello again. Did you manage to work out what Vanstrom and Ranis are up to?

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-the-mercen.speaker: Mercenary
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-the-mercen.text: You might be able to spy on them through one of the windows. You'll need to climb to reach them though.

vampyric-espionage-attempting-to-climb-u.speaker: Vyrewatch
vampyric-espionage-attempting-to-climb-u.text: Get away from there food sack.

vampyric-espionage-attempting-to-climb-u.player: Doesn't look like I'll be able to climb up here with that guard watching. I'll need to distract them somehow.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-harpert.player: Hello. I was wondering if you could help me with something.
Do you think you could distract that guard for me while I climb this wall?

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-harpert.speaker: Harpert
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-harpert.text: I ain't getting on the wrong side of a vyrewatch for nothing. You'll have to pay me.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-harpert.player: 1,000 coins? What can you even buy around here for that?

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-harpert.speaker: Harpert
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-harpert.text: There's a guy in sector three who sells weapons. Top secret, the vampyres can't know about it. I want to buy a sword from him so I have a better chance in the Theatre.
If the player doesn't have 1000 coins:

steps.player: Fine. I'll come back when I have the money.

steps.text: You give Harpert 1,000 coins.

steps.speaker: Harpert
steps.text: Thanks. Climb the wall when you're ready. I'll distract the guard when you do.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-harpert-ta.speaker: Harpert
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-harpert-ta.text: Do you have my money yet?

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-harpert-ta.speaker: Harpert
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-harpert-ta.text: Climb the wall when you're ready. I'll distract the guard when you do.

vampyric-espionage-attempting-to-climb-u.text: You climb up the wall while the vampyre is distracted.

vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.speaker: Ranis Drakan
vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.text: ...and you believe this creature will be suitable?

vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.speaker: Verzik Vitur
vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.text: I have no doubt that it will adequately meet your requirements.

vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.text: Perhaps. But I still believe the vyrewatch can handle this.

vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.speaker: Ranis Drakan
vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.text: We've given your vyrewatch more than enough opportunities and yet the Myreque still elude us. It's time for another strategy.

vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.speaker: Verzik Vitur
vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.text: The creature before you has advantages over a vyre. It is the perfect hunter. Once it gets a taste of its foes blood, it can track them anywhere.

vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.speaker: Ranis Drakan
vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.text: We'd still need the blood though.

vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.text: I may have a solution to that, if this is indeed the route we're taking. There is also the question of your sister. She's specifically requested that Safalaan and that outsider be left to her.

vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.speaker: Ranis Drakan
vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.text: Now is not the time for her games. We can't afford to let the enemy slip through our fingers again.

vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.speaker: Ranis Drakan
vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.text: Anyway, you worry about the Myreque. I'll handle Vanescula.
Vanstrom faces east, seemingly toward where you are spying on.

vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.text: Very well, I will make preparations immediately. The sooner we deal with the Myreque the better. Even our kind have weaknesses and if Serafina could discover them, the Myreque can as well.

vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.speaker: Ranis Drakan
vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.text: Then I think we're done here. Thank you for your time Verzik.

vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.speaker: Verzik Vitur
vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.text: And thank you Ranis. You're always welcome here.

vampyric-espionage-spying-on-ranis-and-v.player: Well that didn't sound good. I'd better let Safalaan know.

vampyric-espionage-reporting-back-to-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
vampyric-espionage-reporting-back-to-saf.text: Hello again, [player name]. Do you have any news for us?

vampyric-espionage-reporting-back-to-saf.player: I do. It's not good I'm afraid.
I managed to spy on a meeting between Vanstrom, Ranis and Verzik Vitur. Verzik gifted them this strange creature which she said would help them track down the Myreque.
She claimed that the creature could track anyone provided it got a taste of their blood.

vampyric-espionage-reporting-back-to-saf.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
vampyric-espionage-reporting-back-to-saf.text: So they'd still need blood from one of us? We might be okay then. It's not like the vampyres name and number the tithes they take.

vampyric-espionage-reporting-back-to-saf.player: I wouldn't be so sure. Vanstrom seemed to think he had a way around that. Not only that, it sounded like he'd be making his move very soon.

vampyric-espionage-reporting-back-to-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
vampyric-espionage-reporting-back-to-saf.text: This isn't good. If Vanstrom thinks he can use this creature against us, I have no reason to disbelieve him. He's proven time and time again that he should not be underestimated.

vampyric-espionage-reporting-back-to-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
vampyric-espionage-reporting-back-to-saf.text: I'm not sure yet. We'll need to make one quickly though.

vampyric-espionage-reporting-back-to-saf.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
vampyric-espionage-reporting-back-to-saf.text: Vertida and I will begin forming a plan of action. In the meantime, do you remember that book on haemalchemy you found for us?

steps.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
steps.text: Well our head researcher, Flaygian Screwte, has been working on translating it. Could you check up on him and see how things are going?

steps.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
steps.text: Following a hint given to you by Sarius Guile, Vanescula Drakan's servant, you found a secret laboratory beneath Meiyerditch. Inside you found a book on haemalchemy.

steps.player: Ah yes. So, what's happening with this book?

steps.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
steps.text: Well our head researcher, Flaygian Screwte, has been working on translating it. Could you check up on him and see how things are going?

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-flaygian.player: Hello there. Safalaan said you were working on translating the haemalchemy book.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-flaygian.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-flaygian.text: Indeed I am. It's not a quick process I'm afraid. Large parts of the book are written using the vampyric language which isn't easy to translate.

options.text: I didn't know the vampyres had their own language.

steps.player: I didn't know the vampyres had their own language.

steps.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
steps.text: Oh yes. It seems to be very old and they don't use it much anymore but it does exist. I suspect it comes in quite useful for things like this where they don't want humans prying into their work.

steps.player: But you can translate it? How's that going so far?

steps.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
steps.text: Like I say, it's slow. My knowledge on the language only comes from things I've seen around the city so I'm having to make a lot of assumptions. I'm making progress though.

steps.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
steps.text: The book seems to document a lot of the experiments being performed in that lab you found. Interestingly, the experiments were performed on vampyres themselves, as well as humans.

steps.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
steps.text: It appears that they were trying to use the power of haemalchemy to modify both humans and vampyres.

steps.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
steps.text: There are some that believe there is a hidden power in blood. Haemalchemy is the act of modifying blood, both magically and scientifically, to harness this power.

steps.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
steps.text: It seems that the vampyres are strong believers in the power of haemalchemy as they've been experimenting quite heavily.

steps.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
steps.text: It looks like they had two reasons. First of all they were looking for a way to increase the amount of blood that can be harvested from a human.

steps.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
steps.text: Unsurprisingly, the vampyres here have multiplied much faster than the humans. Perhaps there's no longer enough blood to go around.

steps.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
steps.text: That's the more interesting one. As we're already aware, vampyres possess some form of immunity against our attacks.

steps.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
steps.text: It starts off as only partial in juveniles and juvinates but by the time they become vyres they are totally invulnerable.

steps.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
steps.text: This book implies that the vampyres immunity isn't perfect and that it can be overcome. It seems they were trying to improve this immunity.

steps.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
steps.text: I haven't got that far yet I'm afraid.

steps.player: Hmmm. I might actually be able to help with that bit. I was spying on Vanstrom and Ranis earlier for Safalaan and I heard Vanstrom say something quite interesting.

steps.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
steps.text: What did he say?

steps.player: He implied that Serafina had discovered their weakness.

steps.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
steps.text: Serafina? As in the Serafina who survived the Theatre of Blood?

steps.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
steps.text: That would actually make a lot of sense. We've always wondered how Serafina managed to survive all of the challenges in the Theatre.

steps.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
steps.text: But what if she never needed to? Maybe she took advantage of the vampyres weakness and forced them to let her leave?

steps.player: Do you think this is worth exploring?

steps.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
steps.text: I do. I'll stay here and keep working on this book. You head out and see if you can find out what Serafina discovered. Safalaan should be able to help you.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-flaygian-a.player: What do I need to do again?

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-flaygian-a.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-flaygian-a.text: We need to find out what Serafina discovered about the vampyres. Talk to Safalaan, he should be able to help you.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.player: Hi Safalaan. How are things going?

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.text: Not good I'm afraid, [player name]. We've looked over our options and we can't see any solution to this problem. If the vampyres truly have the ability to track us then we won't be safe anywhere in Morytania.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.text: We'll have to leave. We should be able to sneak out of Meiyerditch using the same route you did.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.text: We can meet up with Veliaf and the rest of the Myreque in Burgh de Rott. Once we're all together, we can travel to Paterdomus and cross the Salve into Misthalin.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.player: Retreat to Misthalin? But what about all the people here that need our help? They'll die without us.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.text: I know it's not ideal, but we can't help anyone if we're dead. The only place we'll be safe from this new threat is on the other side of the Salve.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.player: There must be another way. What about Roald's mercenaries? Can't they help us?

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.text: Even with their help the vampyres outnumber us ten to one. The only reason we've survived this long is by hiding in the shadows. Once the vampyres know where we are, we'll be doomed.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.text: I'm sorry, [player name]. This isn't the end of our fight though. Once we're in Misthalin we can build up our strength and find more support. We'll come back stronger than ever before.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.text: It will take a while to pack up all of our equipment but we aim to be gone as soon as possible.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.player: Do you think there's time for one last job before we go?

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.text: I guess that depends what it is.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.player: While translating the haemalchemy book, Flaygian found reference to a possible weakness in the vampyres.
Not only that, I also heard Vanstrom talking about this same weakness. He implied that Serafina found a way to take advantage of it.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.text: Serafina? I suspect she's nothing more than a myth. A tale fabricated by the vampyres to drive people to that Theatre of theirs.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.player: But this came from Vanstrom himself.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.text: That is a valid point I guess. Old Man Ral used to tell plenty of stories about Serafina and he did once tell me where she apparently lived.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.text: I suppose we have time to go and have a quick look around while the others pack everything up here.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.text: You'll find the house in sector four. To get there, leave the base, head north and then head west. Go all the way to the western wall and you'll find a broken fountain. The house is the one directly south of the fountain.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan.text: It's best that we travel separately so you head out first and I'll meet you there.

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan-t.player: How can I find the house again?

vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan-t.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
vampyric-espionage-talking-to-safalaan-t.text: You'll find it in sector four. To get there, leave the base, head north and then head west. Go all the way to the western wall and you'll find a broken fountain. The house is the one directly south of the fountain.

the-myth-of-serafina-inspecting-the-brok.player: This looks like the fountain that Safalaan mentioned. Serafina's house must be this one to the south.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: So this is where Serafina lived. Or so they claim.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.player: Everyone else I've spoken to looks up to Serafina, but you don't even think she was real.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: I guess it's not about if she was real or not. It's about what she is now. A symbol. A false one.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Every day, citizens of Meiyerditch throw their lives away in that damn Theatre. All because of her.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.player: But why don't they fight with the Myreque instead?

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: I guess they don't think the vampyres will ever be beaten. They believe that joining the Myreque will lead to certain death.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Thanks to Serafina, they believe that they at least have a chance with the Theatre.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Anyway, I'm getting distracted. There's a locked door here that might be hiding what we're looking for. Let's see if we can find a way to open it.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Found anything yet?

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: We should keep looking.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Found anything yet?

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.player: I found a herb. It's not a type I recognise.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Maybe a potion is needed. See if you can make one. You can get some water from the broken fountain outside.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Found anything yet?

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.player: I found a herb. It's not a type I recognise.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: How odd. We should see if we can find anything else.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Found anything yet?

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.player: I found some ingredients and started making a potion with them.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: A potion? See if you can finish it off.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Found anything yet?

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.player: I found some ingredients and made a potion with them.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Interesting. Maybe there's something you can use it with.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Found anything yet?

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.player: The door has an inscription on it.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: What does it say?

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Blood? Maybe haemalchemy is involved here. We should keep looking around.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Found anything yet?

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.player: I found some ingredients for a potion. I made it and tried using it with the door but nothing happened. I also found an inscription on the door.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: What does it say?

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Hmm... I wonder...

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: I have an idea that may work. Bring me an empty vial.
If the player does not have an empty vial:

steps.text: You hand the empty vial to Safalaan who uses his blade to fill it with his own blood.

steps.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
steps.text: 'Blood is the price of victory.' Now try making the potion with this. If my suspicions are correct it should work.
Vial of blood (A Taste of Hope)

steps.player: Fine. Next time please warn me before you start cutting yourself.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Do you have that vial?
If the player does not have an empty vial:

steps.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
steps.text: Well bring one to me. I have an idea.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.player: Could I have another vial of blood.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: I don't have unlimited blood you know! Use the one you've got.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.player: Could I have another vial of blood.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: I hope you don't think I have unlimited blood to spare. Bring me another vial and try not to lose this one.

steps.text: You hand the empty vial to Safalaan who uses his blade to fill it with his own blood.

steps.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
steps.text: Please be more careful with this one. I'd rather not die of blood loss.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Any luck with that potion?

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Keep at it.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Any luck with that potion?

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.player: I've got a finished potion here.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Well try using it with the door. If my suspicions are correct it should work.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Any luck with that potion?

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.player: It worked this time. The door is unlocked.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Good work. Hopefully there's something useful behind it.

the-myth-of-serafina-searching-the-chest.text: You take some old notes from the chest.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Any luck?

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.player: I found some old notes behind the door.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: Excellent. Hopefully they contain something useful. We should head back to the hideout and give them to Flaygian. I can take them if you want?

steps.text: You give the notes to Safalaan.

steps.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
steps.text: Thanks. We should head back to the hideout.

steps.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
steps.text: As you wish. Just make sure they get to Flaygian at the hideout.

the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-myth-of-serafina-talking-to-safalaan.text: I think we're all done here. We should head back to the hideout.

it-s-a-trap-attempting-to-enter-the-hide.text: Are you sure you want to enter the hideout? Any items left in the hideout, including upon death, will be lost.

it-s-a-trap-attempting-to-enter-the-hide.prompt: Are you sure you want to enter the hideout?

steps.text: The player enters the hideout.

it-s-a-trap-talking-to-flaygian.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
it-s-a-trap-talking-to-flaygian.text: Not yet. I'll let you know once I have something. In the meantime, you should check in with Safalaan.

it-s-a-trap-talking-to-vertida.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
it-s-a-trap-talking-to-vertida.text: Sorry I can't talk right now. I need to prepare for our evacuation.

it-s-a-trap-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
it-s-a-trap-talking-to-safalaan.text: All of the essentials are packed up and ready to go.

it-s-a-trap-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
it-s-a-trap-talking-to-safalaan.text: Excellent. Let the others know that we'll be leaving shortly.

it-s-a-trap-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
it-s-a-trap-talking-to-safalaan.text: I'm looking through these notes you found but there's nothing here.

it-s-a-trap-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Flaygian Screwte
it-s-a-trap-talking-to-safalaan.text: As in nothing. It's just a load of rubbish. Why would Serafina have written this?

it-s-a-trap-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
it-s-a-trap-talking-to-safalaan.text: Because she might not have been the one to write it. [player name], what was it that Verzik said about this creature Vanstrom is using?

it-s-a-trap-talking-to-safalaan.player: That it can track anyone if it has a taste of their blood.

it-s-a-trap-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
it-s-a-trap-talking-to-safalaan.text: And when we were at Serafina's home, we used our blood to open that door.

it-s-a-trap-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
it-s-a-trap-talking-to-safalaan.text: Vanstrom! He used us as bait. Vertida, get the others. We need to leave now!

it-s-a-trap-attack-of-the-abomination.text: A cutscene plays in which the abomination attacks the Myreque Hideout.
The abomination kills Andiess, and moves towards the end of the hideout.
Safalaan unleashes his hidden power, weakening the abomination.

it-s-a-trap-attack-of-the-abomination.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
it-s-a-trap-attack-of-the-abomination.text: It's weakened! Let's finish it off!

it-s-a-trap-the-abomination-s-death.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
it-s-a-trap-the-abomination-s-death.text: I'll be fine. Now we need to get out of here before Vanstrom and his vampyres turn up.

it-s-a-trap-the-abomination-s-death.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
it-s-a-trap-the-abomination-s-death.text: [player name], we have an old hideout beneath Old Man Ral's house in southern Meiyerditch. Meet us there.

it-s-a-trap-talking-to-veliaf-before-tal.player: Vanstrom attacked the Myreque in Meiyerditch!

it-s-a-trap-talking-to-veliaf-before-tal.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
it-s-a-trap-talking-to-veliaf-before-tal.text: Well we need to go help!

it-s-a-trap-talking-to-veliaf-before-tal.player: The attack is already over. We won but there were casualties.

it-s-a-trap-talking-to-veliaf-before-tal.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
it-s-a-trap-talking-to-veliaf-before-tal.text: Damn them vampyres. We need to find a way to turn things in our favour.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-vertida.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-vertida.text: This place isn't as big as the old hideout but it will do for now.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-kael.speaker: Kael Forshaw
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-kael.text: So many dead. The vampyres will pay!

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: Mekritus... Andiess... Flaygian... How many more need to die to those monsters?

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: I knew Serafina was a lie. But I wanted so hard to believe. To believe that someone could have actually beaten those vampyres.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: But I was naive and people died because of it.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: More would have died if not for you. Your magic weakened that thing. We would never have been able to kill it without that.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: To be honest, I don't know. It's a power I've had for as long as I can remember. I've never been able to control it though, it only seems to come on when I'm angry or threatened.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: Indeed. I wish I could tell you more about it but I don't actually remember much about the times it has happened. It's like I have these blank spots in my memory.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: Anyway, now is not the time to dwell on it.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Kael Forshaw
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: So what's the plan boss?

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: We should make our way to Burgh de Rott and meet up with Veliaf and the others.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: What other choice do we have?

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Kael Forshaw
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: I just lost some very good friends of mine. I can't walk away from that. The vampyres need to pay.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: We all nearly died back there. I don't intend to throw any more lives away today. We are leaving.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.player: Just think for a second though. The vampyres will probably think we all died in the attack. They'll have dropped their guard. Now is the best time to retaliate.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: That is a good point.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: It is. However, in case you'd forgotten, we don't have anything to retaliate with. Serafina was a lie, just another one of Vanstrom's little plots.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: We have no weapon to use against the vampyres. And with Flaygian gone, that won't be changing.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: Actually, I think you might be wrong there.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: What do you mean?

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: Flaygian managed to translate some more of the haemalchemy book while you two were investigating Serafina.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: We never got the chance to look over his new discoveries before the attack. However, I did recover his notes as we left.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: Hmmm... All right. [player name], work with Vertida and see if you can finish off Flaygian's work. Make no mistake though, if this doesn't come to anything then we will be leaving.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: Talk to Vertida and see if you can help him finish off Flaygian's work.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-kael-aft.speaker: Kael Forshaw
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-kael-aft.text: Hopefully Flaygian's work will help us against the vampyres.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-vertida-.text: If the player doesn't have inventory space:

steps.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
steps.text: Hello there. I have these notes for us to review. Come back when you have room for them and we'll get started.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-vertida-.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
steps.text: Hello there. Here are the notes Flaygian made. Have a read through and let me know if you need any help.
Vertida gives you some notes.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-vertida-.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-vertida-.text: Do you need any help with Flaygian's notes?

options.text: I need the Rod of Ivandis.

steps.player: I need the Rod of Ivandis.

steps.text: If the player does not have the rod of Ivandis:

steps.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
steps.text: I imagine you'd know more about that than me. Weren't you the one who remade it?

steps.player: I was but I gave it to Veliaf.

steps.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
steps.text: Well I'm sure he still has it. You should ask him if you can have it back. Alternatively, you could always make another.
If the player has the rod of Ivandis:

steps.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
steps.text: Looks like you already have it.

steps.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
steps.text: Do you need anything else?

steps.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
steps.text: Check the crates around here, we should have some chain lying around.

steps.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
steps.text: Do you need anything else?

options.text: I need an enchanted silver sickle.

steps.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
steps.text: Well we have some blessed silver sickles in storage here. You should check the crates. What kind of enchantment does it need?

steps.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
steps.text: Well you'll need to get an emerald and attach it to the sickle. You'll be needing a chisel to do that. Once you've attached the emerald, you should be able to enchant the sickle using an enchantment spell.

steps.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
steps.text: Do you need anything else?

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-vertida-.player: Hello Vertida. I've finished the weapon.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-vertida-.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-vertida-.text: Great work. You should let Safalaan know.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-veliaf.player: I was wondering if I could ask a favour?
Would it be possible for me to have the Rod of Ivandis back?

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-veliaf.text: If the player doesn't have the Rod of Ivandis in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: What do you need it for?

steps.player: I want to convert it into a flail. I have reason to believe that will make it even more effective against vampyres.

steps.text: If the player has one free inventory space:

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Well I can hardly say no to that. Here you go.
If the player has no free inventory space:

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Well I'd be happy to help but you don't have enough room for it.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-veliaf.text: If the player already have one in the inventory:

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Looks like you have one right there.

steps.player: Oh yeah, how didn't I notice.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-veliaf.text: If the player already claimed one from Veliaf:

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: But I already gave it to you.

steps.speaker: Veliaf Hurtz
steps.text: Well you'll just have to make another then. That was the only one I had.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.player: Good news Safalaan, the weapon is complete.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: About time we had some good news. Great work.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: Well I wasn't convinced at first but it turns out you were right. The vampyres seem to believe we're all dead. That's not all though, tell them Kael.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Kael Forshaw
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: Ranis Drakan himself has sent an open invitation to the people of Meiyerditch, inviting them to Ver Sinhaza.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Kael Forshaw
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: Apparently he intends to officially announce the defeat of the Myreque.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: This is quite possibly one of the best opportunities we've ever been given. Ranis Drakan is brother to Lowerniel Drakan himself and is one of the most senior figures in vampyric society.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: And for the first time, we have a weapon that could actually defeat him.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: Exactly. This is our chance to bring real hope to these people. The death of any vampyre would send a strong message but the death of Ranis Drakan could change everything.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Kael Forshaw
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: You don't need to convince me. It's time to show these monsters that their days are done.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: [player name], you are not a citizen of Meiyerditch. You have never felt the pain that these people have. And yet, you have fought for them all the same.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: Now I must ask that you fight for them again. You are the most experienced amongst us. You have the best chance of defeating Ranis.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.player: I've come this far. I'm not about to leave now. What's our plan.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: Take the new weapon and head to Ver Sinhaza. Kael will meet you there. Wait until Ranis has begun his speech, that will be the best time to strike.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: Thank you, [player name]. Myreque prevail.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.player: What do I need to do?

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: Take the new weapon and head to Ver Sinhaza. Kael will meet you there.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-safalaan.text: Thank you, [player name]. Good luck.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-kael-2.speaker: Kael Forshaw
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-kael-2.text: Hello, [player name]. I'll be leaving for Ver Sinhaza soon. You should meet me there.

the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-vertida-.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
the-legendary-weapon-talking-to-vertida-.text: Hello, [player name]. You'd better get moving. Ranis will be starting his speech soon.

steps.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
steps.text: Well I have made a few more. I suppose I could let you have one. I'll have to charge you though, some of this stuff isn't easy to get hold of.

steps.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
steps.text: 20,000 coins should do it.

steps.prompt: Buy an Ivandis Flail for 20,000 coins?

steps.player: Sounds good to me. I'll take it.

steps.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
steps.text: Here you go. Put it to good use
If the player's inventory is full:

steps.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
steps.text: I'm afraid you don't have enough room for it. Come back when you do.
If the player has enough coins:

steps.player: That's a bit too much for me. I guess I'll make myself another one instead.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have enough coins:

steps.player: I don't have that much on me.

steps.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
steps.text: I'll be here when you do.

the-taste-of-hope-talking-to-kael.speaker: Kael Forshaw
the-taste-of-hope-talking-to-kael.text: Well met, [player name]. Ranis will be starting his speech soon. Are you ready?

steps.speaker: Kael Forshaw
steps.text: Very well. Good luck.

steps.speaker: Kael Forshaw
steps.text: Well just let me know when you are.

the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.speaker: Ranis Drakan
the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.text: Citizens of Meiyerditch! I stand before you today so that we may share in a moment of triumph!

the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.speaker: Ranis Drakan
the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.text: For years, the Myreque have lurked in the shadows of this city! Their acts of defiance tainting the greatness that we have all achieved together!

the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.speaker: Ranis Drakan
the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.text: Today, that defiance finally came to an end! Today, we entered the home of the Myreque and eradicated their kind!

the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.speaker: Ranis Drakan
the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.text: Our efforts today would not have been possible without every single one of you. The blood you provide ensures that we remain ever capable of facing these threats.

the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.speaker: Ranis Drakan
the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.text: For that, you should all be proud.

the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.speaker: Ranis Drakan
the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.text: However, while today is very much a day of celebration, it should also act as a reminder.

the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.speaker: Ranis Drakan
the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.text: Rebellion. Resistance. Defiance. These are not the path to freedom. They are merely the path to death.

the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.speaker: Ranis Drakan
the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.text: Anyone who wishes to be free of this life should instead look to Serafina.

the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.speaker: Ranis Drakan
the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.text: Follow in her footsteps. Enter the Theatre and survive. Do this and freedom will be yours.
The player enters and walks up to Ranis.

the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.player: As good as all of that sounds, I do have just a few issues with it.
You stand here claiming the Myreque are dead but I'm here to prove otherwise.
For too long you have lorded yourself over these people. Today, that comes to an end. Today...

the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.speaker: Ranis Drakan
the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.text: You know, over the course of my life, I have tasted more blood than you could ever imagine. The variety of flavours is incredible, and yet, there's one taste that all others pale in comparison to.

the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.speaker: Ranis Drakan
the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.text: You see, there's nothing sweeter than a taste of hope. And you're full of it.

the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.speaker: Ranis Drakan
the-taste-of-hope-ranis-speech.text: I'm going to enjoy killing you.
Ranis turns into his vampyre form.

the-taste-of-hope-the-fight-with-ranis-a.speaker: Ranis Drakan
the-taste-of-hope-the-fight-with-ranis-a.text: I take it you killed that abomination then? It was a human once you know. How does that feel?

the-taste-of-hope-the-fight-with-ranis-a.speaker: Ranis Drakan
the-taste-of-hope-the-fight-with-ranis-a.text: He was doomed. With his illness he'd have soon died with or without our tithing. We saved him, just like she wanted. All for you to just kill him!

the-taste-of-hope-the-fight-with-ranis-a.speaker: Ranis Drakan
the-taste-of-hope-the-fight-with-ranis-a.text: She was one of the smart ones. She was willing! Saving him was all that mattered. She was ready to sacrifice anything for that.

the-taste-of-hope-the-fight-with-ranis-a.speaker: Ranis Drakan
the-taste-of-hope-the-fight-with-ranis-a.text: It's a shame her mind is no longer there. One of the negatives of the process unfortunately. Otherwise I'd have introduced you. I'm sure she'd have loved to meet her brother's killer.

the-taste-of-hope-a-speech-of-hope.player: Sooo... I guess this is the part where I say something...
For hundreds of years, the people of Morytania have suffered under Lord Lowerniel Drakan and his vampyres.
For too long, they've filled you with false hope. Hope of freedom. All you have to do is follow Serafina and you'll be free. Or so they claim.
Well whoever Serafina was, she is gone. There is no freedom in that Theatre. No hope. Just lies. If freedom is truly what you want, there is another path.
You see, the vampyres are not as powerful as they'd have you believe. Ranis Drakan lies dead before you. Killed by a mere human. If he can die, so can the rest.
So now, I ask that you join us. Fight alongside the Myreque and together, we will push back the darkness of Hallowvale.
Together, we will end the tyranny of the Drakan family. Together, we will bring hope to all of Morytania.

finishing-up.speaker: Kael Forshaw
finishing-up.text: That was amazing, [player name]. Now you'd better get back to the hideout. This place will be filled with vampyres soon.

finishing-up-returning-to-safalaan.player: Good news Safalaan, Ranis Drakan is no more!

finishing-up-returning-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
finishing-up-returning-to-safalaan.text: I've already heard. The whole city is talking about it.

finishing-up-returning-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
finishing-up-returning-to-safalaan.text: [player name], it can never be understated what you have done today. This is the turning of the tide in our battle and it's all down to you.

finishing-up-returning-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
finishing-up-returning-to-safalaan.text: Lowerniel Drakan is unlikely to ignore the death of his brother. He will do everything he can to destroy us. I don't expect things to be easy for us from here.

finishing-up-returning-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
finishing-up-returning-to-safalaan.text: However, thanks to you, we should hopefully see more support for our own cause. You've finally given these people something to fight for. Something real.

finishing-up-returning-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
finishing-up-returning-to-safalaan.text: We'll start planning what our next steps should be right away. You can leave that to us though, you've earnt a break.

finishing-up-returning-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
finishing-up-returning-to-safalaan.text: Also, it seems only right that you are rewarded for what you've done today. I can't offer much but I do have this tome of knowledge that might come in useful. I think Kael has something for you as well.

finishing-up-returning-to-safalaan.speaker: Kael Forshaw
finishing-up-returning-to-safalaan.text: That's right. I recovered this medallion from Ranis, you might find a good use for it.
Kael shows you Ranis Drakan's medallion.

finishing-up-returning-to-safalaan.speaker: Safalaan Hallow
finishing-up-returning-to-safalaan.text: Anyway, we'll let you get off. And once again, [player name], thank you.

options.text: Do you have another Drakan's medallion?

steps.speaker: Kael Forshaw
steps.text: Of course.

steps.speaker: Kael Forshaw
steps.text: Much better thanks to you. It actually feels like we're winning for once.

finishing-up-talking-to-vertida.speaker: Vertida Sefalatis
finishing-up-talking-to-vertida.text: Good to have you here, [player name]. Everything seems to feel more positive when you're around.

finishing-up-epilogue.text: A cutscene plays, showing Ranis' corpse. Vanescula Drakan and Vanstrom Klause approach the body.

finishing-up-epilogue.speaker: Vanstrom Klause
finishing-up-epilogue.text: Hmmm... Lord Drakan won't be pleased about this.
